forward_pe.formula_description: Price target derived from forward EPS multiplied by a target P/E. Historical median is used when available; otherwise the configured fallback applies.

net_debt.notes: Derived net debt; normalize_snapshot publishes it on the snapshot.

forward_eps.notes: Calculated from 365/365 remaining days in fiscal year

pe_multiple_low.source: Derived low range from historical median (AVGO TEST/DEMO fixture)
pe_multiple_low.notes: P/E low: multiple_source=historical; derived ±10% scenario range

pe_multiple_base.notes: P/E base: multiple_source=historical; observed historical median

pe_multiple_high.source: Derived high range from historical median (AVGO TEST/DEMO fixture)
pe_multiple_high.notes: P/E high: multiple_source=historical; derived ±10% scenario range

calculation_steps: Forward EPS = 19.21 [NTM (w0=1.00, w1=0.00); NTM day-weighted blend: 100.0% FY1 (19.21) + 0.0% FY2 (22.50); as_of=2025-01-15; estimated=True]
P/E multiples (low/base/high) = 19.8000/22.0000/24.2000 [historical; Historical median P/E (AVGO TEST/DEMO fixture)]

ev_ebitda.formula: EV = Forward EBITDA × Multiple; Price = (EV - Net Debt) / Shares
ev_ebitda.formula_description: EV = forward EBITDA × multiple; equity value = EV − net debt; price per share = equity value / diluted shares.

net_debt.notes: Derived net debt; normalize_snapshot publishes it on the snapshot.

market_cap.source: Derived from current quote × diluted shares
market_cap.notes: Market capitalization used as an exposed EV/EBITDA intermediate.

multiple_low.source: Derived low range from historical median (AVGO TEST/DEMO fixture)

multiple_high.source: Derived high range from historical median (AVGO TEST/DEMO fixture)

calculation_steps: Forward EBITDA = 39200000000 [forward_1y; Derived from base EBITDA (28000000000) × (1 + 40.0%); as_of=2025-01-15; estimated=True]
Multiples (low/base/high) = 21.6000/24.0000/26.4000 [historical; Historical median EV/EBITDA (AVGO TEST/DEMO fixture)]

fcf_yield.formula: Equity Value = Forward FCFE / Yield Rate; Price = Equity / Shares
fcf_yield.formula_description: FCFE (equity free cash flow) divided by the target yield rate, then divided by shares. FCFF is never substituted or discounted in this model.

net_debt.notes: Derived net debt; normalize_snapshot publishes it on the snapshot.

yield_low.notes: low; low scenario is the high-yield conservative case

yield_base.notes: base; low scenario is the high-yield conservative case

yield_high.notes: high; low scenario is the high-yield conservative case

calculation_steps: IMPORTANT: Uses FCFE (equity FCF), NOT FCFF (firm FCF used by DCF)
Forward FCFE = 112000000000 [forward_1y; Derived from base FCFE (80000000000) × (1 + 40.0%); as_of=2025-01-15; estimated=True]
Low valuation uses the highest yield; high valuation uses the lowest yield.

dcf.formula: EV = Σ FCFF_t/(1+WACC)^t + TV/(1+WACC)^5; Equity = EV − Net Debt; Price = Equity/Shares
dcf.formula_description: Five-year FCFF DCF. PV_t = FCFF_t/(1+WACC)^t; TV = FCFF5×(1+g)/(WACC-g); PVTV = TV/(1+WACC)^5; EV = ΣPV + PVTV; equity = EV − debt + cash; price = equity/shares.

inputs.fcff_y1_label: Forward FCFF FY1E [Derived from base FCFF (70000000000) × (1 + 40.0%)]
inputs.fcff_y2_label: Forward FCFF FY2E [Derived from Year 1 FCFF × (1 + 40.0%)]
inputs.fcf_type: FCFF (firm/unlevered FCF — discounted at WACC, NOT FCFE)

net_debt.notes: Derived net debt; normalize_snapshot publishes it on the snapshot.

fcff_ttm.notes: Free Cash Flow to Firm: EBIT*(1-tax) + D&A - capex - ΔNWC. DCF model ONLY (discounted at WACC).
